summary: Added a RuntimeAuditProjection over AuditJournal timelines, exposed latest/run-id projection through CLI and TUI render paths, and covered stable ordering, redaction, denied/no-effect, recovery-source, and malformed-line warning behavior.

projection_contract.raw_audit_surface_preserved: --audit-show still returns the raw run timeline JSON array
projection_contract.redaction: Projection uses audit redaction, preserves secret:// handles, and redacts password/token/api-key-like values.

verification.cargo run -p agentd -- --service-recover: generated approved generic AgentCore service recovery audit journal
projected 41 events with IntentReceived, PlanFrozen, PolicyEvaluated, ApprovalBound, EffectPrepared, EffectObserved, CommitSealed, source=semantic-tool, and trust=sandboxed-tool

acceptance: Operators can see why each step ran, paused, denied, recovered, rolled back, or sealed.
Projection ties model-assisted planning events to deterministic policy/effect audit events.
Projection includes observation source and trust labels when present.
Projection does not leak raw secret-like values.
Projection output is stable enough for unit and CLI smoke verification.
